On this page
POST Historical Bars
NT8
Tradovate
Pull historical OHLCV bars NT8​

Retrieves closed historical OHLCV bars for any instrument available in NinjaTrader from the connected data feed. This is an async operation that requests data from NT8's historical data infrastructure, so the response may take a moment depending on the date range and bar type.

The CrossTrade NT8 add-on implements this endpoint with NinjaTrader.Data.BarsRequest and returns the req.Bars collection directly. CrossTrade does not subscribe to live market data, append a still-forming current bar, or return an isForming flag for this endpoint. Treat the response as NT8 historical, closed-bar data. If your strategy needs a strict live-boundary guard, set to to the last completed period boundary or drop any bar whose timestamp is at or after the period currently forming in your session context.

Endpoint​

POST /v1/api/market/bars

Headers​
NAME	VALUE
Content-Type	application/json
Authorization	Bearer <token>
Body parameters​

This is a POST request, parameters are sent as a JSON body.

NAME	TYPE	REQUIRED	DESCRIPTION
instrument	string	Required	Instrument name (e.g., "ES 12-26")
periodType	string	Optional	Bar type. Default: "minute". Options: minute, day, week, month, year
period	int	Optional	Bar period value. Default: 1. Example: 5 for 5-minute bars
daysBack	int	Optional	Number of days of history. Default: 1. Ignored if from is provided
from	string	Optional	Start date in UTC (e.g., "2026-03-17T00:00:00Z")
to	string	Optional	End date in UTC. Default: now
limit	int	Optional	Maximum number of bars to return (taken from the most recent). Default: 5000.
Code examples​
Python
JavaScript
cURL
import requests



token = 'my-secret-token'

url = "https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/market/bars"

headers = {

    "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",

    "Content-Type": "application/json"

}



data = {

    "instrument": "ES 12-26",

    "periodType": "minute",

    "period": 5,

    "daysBack": 1,

    "limit": 3

}



try:

    response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=data)

    print(f"Response Code: {response.status_code}, Response Text: {response.text}")

except Exception as e:

    print(f"An error occurred: {e}")

Response​
200
400
401

500
{

  "instrument": "ES 12-26",

  "periodType": "minute",

  "period": 5,

  "count": 1,

  "bars": [

    {

      "time": "2026-03-18T20:00:00.0000000Z",

      "epoch": 1773864000000,

      "open": 6731.75,

      "high": 6731.75,

      "low": 6731.75,

      "close": 6731.75,

      "volume": 1

    }

  ],

  "success": true

}

Success field types​
FIELD	TYPE	DESCRIPTION
success	boolean	true on success.
instrument, periodType	string	Contract and bar-period type.
period, count	integer	Period size and returned bar count.
bars	array of objects	Historical bars.
bars[].time	string	ISO 8601 bar time.
bars[].epoch	integer	Unix milliseconds.
bars[].open, bars[].high, bars[].low, bars[].close	float	OHLC prices.
bars[].volume	integer	Bar volume.
Platform nuances​
WARNING

The request has a 10-second timeout. If NinjaTrader's data infrastructure takes longer than that to load the requested bars (which can happen with very large date ranges or exotic bar types), the response will return a timeout error. In that case, try reducing the date range or bar count.

WebSocket API​

This request can also be made over the WebSocket API. All parameters are passed inside args.

{

  "action": "rpc",

  "id": "my-request-id",

  "api": "GetBars",

  "args": {

    "instrument": "ES 12-26",

    "periodType": "minute",

    "period": 5,

    "daysBack": 1,

    "limit": 100

  }

}


With an explicit date range:

{

  "action": "rpc",

  "id": "my-request-id",

  "api": "GetBars",

  "args": {

    "instrument": "ES 12-26",

    "periodType": "day",

    "period": 1,

    "from": "2026-03-01T00:00:00Z",

    "to": "2026-03-18T00:00:00Z"

  }

}
